title: fix(spec): manifest.namespace refusal and TSDoc name the leading-letter rule
body:
Fixes #19831
Clause-②: no

`manifest.namespace` is enforced by `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,19}$`, so its first character must be a lowercase letter. The refusal sentence and the TSDoc `Rules:` line only stated the length and the charset. `1leave` and `_leave` satisfied every clause an author was shown, and the regex still refused them. This PR makes both texts state what the regex enforces. The regex is byte-identical, so the accept set does not move.

## What changes

| surface | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ManifestSchema.namespace` refusal (`packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts`) | `Namespace must be 2-20 chars, lowercase alphanumeric + underscore` | `Namespace must be 2-20 chars, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores` |
| same key, TSDoc `Rules:` line | `2-20 characters, lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only.` | `2-20 characters, starting with a lowercase letter; lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only (1leave and _leave are refused).` |
| `PackageSchema.namespace` refusal (`packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts`). Through it, `CreatePackageRequestSchema.namespace` and the scaffold-only `TemplateManifestSchema.namespace` too | byte-identical copy of the old sentence | the new sentence, byte-identical to the manifest's |

The `package.zod.ts` copy is the second author-facing restatement. The step-1 sweep below found it in `packages/spec`, triage's grading named it, and the dispatch authorised fixing it here. If only one copy changed, the manifest and the publish payload would prescribe two different rules for one vocabulary. Its in-code comment now says that the sentence is kept identical as well as the pattern.

The new sentence has no trailing period on purpose. `duplicatePackage` in `metadata-protocol` appends `. ` after the declaration's message (`protocol.ts`, the explicit-`targetNamespace` and derived-namespace refusals).

## Measured, before and after

Each value was parsed through `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` from source: `origin/main` `0e90a8d1c5` before, this branch `27704f4cc2` after.

| value | before | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `1leave` | refused, old sentence | refused, new sentence |
| `_leave` | refused, old sentence | refused, new sentence |
| `a` (1 char) | refused, old sentence | refused, new sentence |
| 21-char name | refused, old sentence | refused, new sentence |
| `Leave` | refused, old sentence | refused, new sentence |
| `leave`, `ab`, 20-char name | accepted | accepted |

All refusals are one issue with code `invalid_format`. The verdicts are identical on both sides. Only the text changed.

## Restatement census (step 1)

This is `git grep` over the whole tree at `0e90a8d1c5`, for the regex literal, the sentence, `2-20 chars`, `2-20 characters` and `alphanumeric + underscore`. CHANGELOGs and release pages are excluded.

|:--|:--|:--|

| `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package.zod.ts` refusal | no (same sentence) | fixed here |
| `packages/spec/src/api/endpoint-publish-gate.ts` refusal (`apis:` without a legal namespace) | yes, it quotes the regex | none |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/namespace-prefix.ts` code comment `(2-20 chars)` | partial, but it is an internal comment directly above the regex literal and not author-facing | none |
| `packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts` refusal + docblock | yes ("a lowercase letter followed by lowercase letters, digits or underscores") | outside `packages/spec`, none |
| `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts` docblock | yes, it quotes the regex | outside `packages/spec`, none |
| `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts` docblock | yes, it quotes the regex | outside `packages/spec`, none |
| `content/docs/api/declarative-endpoints.mdx` | yes, it quotes the regex | outside `packages/spec`, none |
| `docs/adr/0048-…`, `docs/adr/0121-…` | yes, they quote the regex | outside `packages/spec`, none |
| `.changeset/19577-duplicate-package-explicit-namespace.md` (unreleased) | it quotes the OLD sentence verbatim as `duplicatePackage`'s refusal text | outside `packages/spec`, not edited. See Acceptance notes |
| `skills/**` | no restatement of the charset rule | none |
| `content/docs/references/**` (generated) | renders the `.describe()` text only, which states no rule | none |

## Pins of the old sentence (step 4)

This is `git grep` over all of `packages/` (and `examples/`, `apps/`, `scripts/`) for the sentence and its fragments.

- `packages/spec/src/marketplace/package-namespace.test.ts` pinned it verbatim twice (`PackageSchema` and `TemplateManifestSchema` refusals). Both now pin the new text.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.duplicate-package-target-namespace.test.ts` reads the sentence from `ManifestSchema.shape.namespace` at run time and never retypes it. No edit was needed, and it passes against the rebuilt spec.
- Zero other hits. The sibling `objectui` (`origin/main` `544ecba`) has zero hits too, with the control word `namespace` hitting.

## Generated artifacts (step 5)

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` then `check:generated`: all 15 generated artifacts are up to date, and nothing was regenerated or committed. The `.describe()` text is unchanged, so `content/docs/references/kernel/manifest.mdx` does not move. The built `dist/` carries the new sentence in 18 files and the old one in 0.

## Changeset (step 6)

`.changeset/manifest-namespace-leading-letter-refusal.md` is `"@objectstack/spec": patch`. The reading:

- AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3 says a bug fix in a released package takes a `patch`.
- The shipped text of `@objectstack/spec` changes: the built `dist/` carries the new sentence, so `skip-changeset` does not apply.
- `Clause-②: no`: no authorable key is added, removed, widened or narrowed, and the regex and accept set are byte-identical.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` ships no changed bytes, because it reads the message at run time. So it has no changeset entry.

## Tests

All of these ran at `27704f4cc2` unless another commit is noted.

- New pins in `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.test.ts`: `1leave` and `_leave` are refused as exactly one `invalid_format` issue, and the message matches `start with a lowercase letter`. The same sentence still names `2-20 chars` and the charset. As a control, `leave`, `crm`, `my_app_2`, `a1` and a 20-char name still parse, both on the field and in a whole manifest.
- New pin in `package-namespace.test.ts` ("two gates, one vocabulary"): all four namespace fields refuse `1leave` with the manifest's exact sentence. The existing verdict table could not see the prose, and this pin closes that class of drift.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 525 files passed, 15503 tests passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` (tsc + scripts + `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0, and the debt ledger is unchanged.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: built its dependency closure, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test` ran 188 files passed and 3 skipped, and 2673 tests passed and 19 skipped. The verbose run of `protocol.duplicate-package-target-namespace.test.ts` passed 13/13.
- **Firing control**, at `48ea3d9960` (same `packages/spec` tree): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` put today's sentence back through an anchor that must hit, with a shell trap restoring from `HEAD`.
  - Leg 1 changed `manifest.zod.ts` only. It went red, 4 failed / 85 passed: both leading-letter pins, the charset pin, and the four-field sentence pin.
  - Leg 2 changed `package.zod.ts` only (drift between the two declarations). It went red, 3 failed / 86 passed: the four-field sentence pin and both verbatim pins.
  - Restored, it went back to green, 89/89. The restore was proven by blob hash equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD` for both files. Nothing was left in the tree.
- Lint was narrowed to the 4 touched `.ts` files: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json`, 4 files reported, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population comes from eslint's own `isPathIgnored` (false for all 4). The config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` at `27704f4cc2` derived 83 commands. All 83 ran, and `--ran` reconciles them as 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Three gates first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, workspace `dist/` absent): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt`. After `turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' --filter='./packages/*/*'` all three exit 0. Six roster gates in directories this diff touches also exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`. The spec `repo` vitest project and the CI-only jobs are left to CI.

This branch is based on `0e90a8d1c5`. `origin/main` is 4 commits ahead (`2bbb462335`). None of them touches a file in this diff, and their diff has zero hits for the sentence.

## Acceptance notes

- **Sibling key, same class, not fixed here.** The dispatch rules out every other `ManifestSchema` key. `manifest.id` / `PackageSchema.manifestId` (`manifestIdRefusal`, same file) say "lowercase dot-separated segments; hyphens allowed inside a segment, underscores are not.", but the pattern also requires each segment to open with a letter. Measured at `0e90a8d1c5`: `com.example.2app` and `com.2example.app` are refused with exactly that sentence and no suggestion. They satisfy every clause it states. This is reported for the seat to file.
- **The unreleased changeset `.changeset/19577-duplicate-package-explicit-namespace.md` (line 15)** quotes the old sentence as the text `duplicatePackage` returns. After this PR that quote describes text the runtime no longer produces. It is outside `packages/spec`, so it is not edited here. This PR's own changeset states the new sentence and names `duplicatePackage`, so the same release carries the correction. The replacement for the quoted fragment is `Namespace must be 2-20 chars, start with a lowercase letter, and contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores`.
- PR #19637 edits the `version` key and the imports of `manifest.zod.ts`, and PR #19789 regenerates `manifest.mdx`. This PR touches neither region and moves no generated file.
